why: **Living, and deliberately listed with his profession.** *David's rule of 22 September is that the living rule is **family only, as written** — strangers found in public indexes keep their dates.* **`conn: "no"` says he is not family**, and this section exists to list the people who carried the name and are searched for. *The conservatoire post and the 2019 records are the reason he is here at all; withholding them would leave a bare living name on a page about public figures, which protects nobody and informs nobody.* **The flag is set all the same**, so that no living-person gate is blind to him: *the string «living» sitting in a date field is not something a checker that reads flags can see.*
